d:
When people are placed at the heart of progress, meaningful change follows.
‘Powering People’ celebrates the human stories of NTPC’s five decades journey —from employees who power this nation, to communities whose lives have been transformed through opportunity, empowerment, and hope.
This is the story of a legacy built by people, for people.
‘Powering People’ is the final episode of the three-part series, ‘NTPC: Powering India’, on National Geographic.
produced by National Geographic CreativeWorks
